g.text: Four factual questions about unemployment, taxes, California and the electorate.
Each social group contained one political party; participants were not told their peers shared that affiliation.
Becker, Porter & Centola (2019) | doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1817195116 | Original author release
Panel estimate = geometric mean. Equal weight across groups; no mixed-party panels are constructed.
Bootstrap resamples intact groups within party, retaining both rounds and all questions.
Every facet uses its own initial reference. Dashed = before feedback; solid = after revision.
k counts reports sampled from existing groups. It is not the number of participants needed to run the social experiment.
